% Mass conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:mass}
\nabla\cdot(\rho\mathbf{v}) + \frac{\partial}{\partial t} \rho{\left(x,y,z,t \right)} = 0
\end{equation}

% Lorentz force identity (J×B expansion)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:lorentz_identity}
(\nabla\times\mathbf{B})\times\mathbf{B} = \nabla\cdot(\mathbf{B}\otimes\mathbf{B}) - \nabla\left(\tfrac{1}{2}|\mathbf{B}|^2\right) - (\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B})\,\mathbf{B}
\end{equation}

% Total (magneto-fluid) pressure
\begin{equation}\label{eq:pstar}
P^{\star} \equiv p + \tfrac{1}{2}|\mathbf{B}|^{2}
\end{equation}

% Momentum conservation (divergence form)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:mom_conservative}
\partial_t(\rho\mathbf{v}) + \nabla\!\cdot\!\left[\rho\,\mathbf{v}\otimes\mathbf{v} - \mathbf{B}\otimes\mathbf{B} + P^{\star}\mathbf{I}\right] = \mathbf{0}
\end{equation}

% Induction (tensor-divergence form)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:induction_tensor}
\partial_t B_i + \partial_j\!\left(v_j B_i - v_i B_j\right) = 0
\end{equation}

% Induction (curl form, equivalent)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:induction_curl}
\partial_t \mathbf{B} = \nabla\times(\mathbf{v}\times\mathbf{B})
\end{equation}

% Total energy density (hydro + magnetic)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:total_energy}
E = \rho e + \tfrac{1}{2}\rho|\mathbf{v}|^{2} + \tfrac{1}{2}|\mathbf{B}|^{2}
\end{equation}

% Total-energy conservation
\begin{equation}\label{eq:energy_conservation}
\partial_t E + \nabla\!\cdot\!\left[(E + P^{\star})\mathbf{v} - \mathbf{B}(\mathbf{B}\cdot\mathbf{v})\right] = 0
\end{equation}

% Solenoidal constraint (continuous level)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:divB_preservation}
\partial_t\!\left(\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}\right) = 0
\end{equation}

% Summary: compact conservative form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:mhd_compact}
\partial_t \mathbf{U} + \partial_i \mathbf{F}_i(\mathbf{U}) = \mathbf{0}, \quad \mathbf{U} = (\rho,\ \rho\mathbf{v},\ \mathbf{B},\ E)^{\mathrm{T}}
\end{equation}
